description: Sync step 2. Render-ready PUBLISHED side page: typed content, resolved assets[] with absolute fileUrl, slotMap, navigation, siteMetadata, canonicalUrl, breadcrumb, schemaGraph (JSON-LD @graph: Organization, WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, comparison ItemList), plus meta (contentHash, updatedAt, publishedAt, publishedVersionId, path, assetMode). meta.assetMode 'client' (page distribution 'external') means asset keys (assets, slotMap, logo/OG images, slot refs) are deliberately omitted — the site supplies its own. Full payload, never truncated. Nested keys: features/a or features~a.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

ifContentHash.description: meta.contentHash from your last export of this item; if unchanged you get { unchanged: true } instead of the body.

landingPageSlug.description: Parent landing page slug (rows from list_content_changes carry it as parentSlug).

version.description: "published" (default) = what is live. "draft" = the editor's current version, for previews only.

name: export_side_page
